title: Compactly supported finite-mass IM filling of an IM boundary for d < P, using the in-range isoperimetric filling (parent step 3, V3)
statement: Assume (MR), (IMC)(c), (VO) and (Isor). (MR) is the frozen type of the accepted cmc_massOn_eq_imRep_measure: M_W(X) = R.measure(W) whenever the IMRep R represents X ∈ 𝒟_n(U), U open, W open. (IMC)(c): for all P, n, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P and IM A, B ∈ 𝒟_n(U), A − B is IM. (VO) is the frozen type of the accepted dtc_vanish_off_support: S(ω) = 0 for every current S ∈ 𝒟_n(U) and every ω ∈ 𝒟ⁿ(U) whose topological support is disjoint from spt S. (Isor) is the in-range isoperimetric filling, verbatim the corresponding hypothesis of the selected node (the second conjunct of the frozen type of dtc_bc_tc_cl_deformation_isoperimetric): for all P, m ∈ ℕ with m + 1 < P there is a real c ≥ 1 such that every IM Z ∈ 𝒟_{m+1}(ℝ^P) with compact support, ∂Z = 0 and M(Z) < ∞ equals ∂Y for an IM Y ∈ 𝒟_{m+2}(ℝ^P) with M(Y) ≤ c(2cM(Z))^{1/(m+1)}M(Z) and spt Y ⊆ {x : dist(x, spt Z) < 3√P(2cM(Z))^{1/(m+1)}}. Let P, d ∈ ℕ with d < P, and let T ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(ℝ^P) have compact support, with M(∂T) < ∞ and ∂T IM. Then there is an IM Y ∈ 𝒟_{d+1}(ℝ^P) with ∂Y = ∂T, M(Y) < ∞ and spt Y compact. Notation: SimonGMT currents in U = ℝ^P, M = mass = M_{ℝ^P}, spt = GeometricCurrentOn.support, IM = IsIntegerMultiplicity. This is the unaccepted dmcbr_cc_compact_im_filling / cbr_cc_compact_im_filling with the isoperimetric hypothesis restricted to the range m + 1 < P.
lean_statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (R : IMRep U n), IsOpen U → R.Represents T → ∀ W : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen W → T.massOn W = R.measure W) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (A B : GeometricCurrentOn U n), IsOpen U → IsIntegerMultiplicity A → IsIntegerMultiplicity B → IsIntegerMultiplicity (A - B)) → (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n), Disjoint (tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n)) S.support → S ω = 0) → (∀ (P m : ℕ), m + 1 < P → ∃ c : ℝ, 1 ≤ c ∧ ∀ Z : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity Z → IsCompact Z.support → Z.boundary = 0 → Z.mass < ∞ → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2), IsIntegerMultiplicity Y ∧ Y.boundary = Z ∧ Y.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c * (2 * c * Z.mass.toReal) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / (m + 1)) * Z.mass.toReal) ∧ Y.support ⊆ thickening (3 * Real.sqrt P * (2 * c * Z.mass.toReal) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / (m + 1))) Z.support) → ∀ (P d : ℕ), d < P → ∀ (T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1)), IsCompact T.support → T.boundary.mass < ∞ → IsIntegerMultiplicity T.boundary → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (d + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity Y ∧ Y.boundary = T.boundary ∧ Y.mass < ∞ ∧ IsCompact Y.support
